sections.Usage:
When water flows over a Water Wheel, it will begin to rotate. This rotational power can be conveyed to other
Components
from the Water Wheels'
Shaft
.

Water Wheels can also be powered by
Lava
,
Chocolate
, and
Bubble Columns
.

As long as the water flows around the wheel in mostly one direction, the Wheel will generate
Rotational Force
.
sections.Appearance:
The Water Wheel's appearance can be changed by right-clicking any type of
Planks
on it. The items will not be consumed. Each texture is automatically generated using the planks and logs of a wood type, allowing for some compatibility with other mods.
sections.Output:
The direction of rotation of the water wheel corresponds to the net flow of fluid around the wheel. For the standard water wheel, the 4 blocks adjacent to the wheel are checked for fluid flow while for the large water wheel, the 12 blocks surrounding the center 3x3 frame are checked. The strength of the flow of each block does not influence the result, only the direction.

The standard water wheel outputs rotation at 8 RPM and 256 SU. The large water wheel outputs rotation at 4 RPM and 512 SU.
sections.Pre 0.5.1:
The water wheel has a correct direction of rotation, shown by how the blades are oriented. Water flowing the wrong way around the wheel causes it to produce less rotational speed and stress capacity than if the water was flowing the right way. Having water flowing in the opposite directions might slow down the rotational speed or even stop it. The direction of rotation is counter-clockwise when placed standing, or clockwise when crouching.

Note that
Soul Sand
bubble columns can also be used to increase the speed.

The maximum SU can also be achieved in a horizontal water wheel without Soul Sand by making a single water source block flow around the wheel.

Lava can be used as well, but this is not recommended as it produces less power and is quite dangerous, and as such does
not comply with OSHA standards
.

To maximize the output from a Water Wheel (320 SU), have water flowing in the right direction around as much of the wheel as possible, like vertically or horizontally.

Water wheels can be placed side-by-side to add together their stress capacities.

Water wheels can also be powered by
Lava
and
Chocolate
and will grant advancements upon doing so.

sections.Usage:
To select a target, sneak+use the ejector on the desired target block, then place the ejector some distance away. The target must be in a straight axial (on the same X/Z axis) line from where the Ejector is placed. The maximum range of the selection target is 32 blocks horizontally, and infinite blocks vertically, but placing the target higher than 33-35 blocks will only result in a slight increase in launch height.

The ejector can be recharged by connecting rotational power to its input. Recharge time increases with distance, but can be sped up by increasing the input's RPM. Rotating the input the wrong way will also increase the recharge time slightly--with the ejector facing to the right, the correct input direction is counter-clockwise.

The amount of items ejected can be adjusted in the
Value Settings Screen
accessible from the front, back, or the gold square under the ejector's plate. The Ejector will wait until it has the appropriate amount of items before launching them.
sections.Tips::
Items flung still collide with blocks, but cannot be picked up or stopped by the player.
If the Ejector is rotated or moved via
contraption
or
wrench
, the target moves with it.
If the player is wearing Elytra, the ejector will deploy the elytra automatically, allowing them to fly great distances.

sections.Intro:
The
Ponder
scene for the
Windmill Bearing
.

A windmill generates
Rotational Force
. It is composed of a
Windmill Bearing
(or
Mechanical Bearing
in pre 0.3 versions) and at least 8 sails or sail-like blocks. Due to the easy access to its components, the windmill along with the
Water Wheel
are the earliest automatic power generators in the game.

Sail-like blocks include:

Windmill Sails
Windmill Sail Frames
Wool Blocks
Copycat Panels
equipped with another sail-like block
sections.Contents:
1
Usage
2
Advancements
3
Gallery
4
History
sections.Usage:
A windmill is created by attaching any block to the front of the
Windmill Bearing
to act as a hub, then attaching multiple sail blocks to the hub bock.  The
Windmill Bearing
comes with glue already on the face to which the hub block attaches. When attaching sails and sail frames, they attach even without glue. Wool and additional blocks may be attached with
Super Glue
. The additional blocks are decorative only. Only the sail-like blocks generate power.

Sail blocks include
Windmill Sails
,
Sail Frames
, and
Wool
blocks. The windmill's angular velocity increases by 1 RPM each time the number of sail-like blocks increases by 8, only starting to rotate once there are 8 sail-like blocks. The amount of stress generated is 512 su per RPM. Sails will automatically connect to each other and to blocks that have already been attached. The sails can be placed in any configuration; the shape does not matter.

Right-click the
Windmill Bearing
anywhere but the center with an empty hand to start the windmill.  To stop it, right-click on the block with an empty hand again. To change the spin direction, right-click and hold on the center of the bearing where a circular arrow appears. Hold down the right mouse key and either scroll the wheel or move the mouse left and right to select the direction.

sections.Power Generation:
The
Ponder
scene for the
Windmill Bearing
.

In order to begin generating power, a Windmill Bearing must have at least eight
Sails
,
Sail Frames
,
Wool
blocks, or
Copycat Panels
equipped with wool attached. Any other block can also be attached with
Super Glue
, though it will not yield any benefit. This will create a
Windmill
.

By default, the Windmill Bearing spins clockwise, though this can be changed to counter-clockwise with the
Wrench
. For every 8 sail-type blocks connected to the Windmill Bearing, it gains 1 RPM and 512su (8-15 sails gives 512su at 1 RPM, 16-23 gives 1024su at 2 RPM, etc.). A Windmill will produce a maximum of 8192su (128 sail-type blocks).

sections.Power Generation:

Windmill Bearing
, the Windmill Sail will generate power with the same effectiveness as
Wool

Sheared
into Sail Frames.

sections.Intro:
Zinc
is a material found in the
overworld
. It spawns naturally as zinc ore and can be smelted into ingots or crushed into
Crushed Zinc Ore
.
sections.Items:
Zinc Ingot
— an item created by smelting zinc ore or crushed zinc ore.
Crushed Zinc Ore
— an item obtained by crushing zinc ore or zinc blocks. Can be smelted into zinc ingots or washed into zinc nuggets.
Zinc Nugget
— an item that can be crafted into a zinc ingot. Can be used to craft the
Andesite Alloy
.
sections.Blocks:
Zinc Ore
— an ore found underground, and an item obtained by mining it. Can be smelted into zinc ingots or crushed into crushed zinc ore.
Block of Zinc
— a block used for compact zinc storage, and to create the base/pyramid for a
beacon
.
